intro: Nine articles from Check Point Research, published between April 26 and October 23, 2026, cover activity tied to Aokigahara, Handala Hack, and JSCeal. The research also examines CVE-2024-55591, CVE-2025-32433, and CVE-2025-33073. Government, business services, consumer, critical infrastructure, and cryptocurrency rank among the most affected sectors, while China, Europe, Global, Israel, and Mexico appear among the most affected regions. Six of the nine reports carry a high severity rating and two are rated critical. The archive collects the full run of Check Point Research coverage across this period.
